Comparison models Inflection-2, Grok 1, GPT-4/3.5, Claude 2 mapped to seed ids where clear; LLAMA-2 size unspecified so rawModelName used. PaLM 2-L kept as rawModelName. Some Table 2 secondary rows (MMLU 5-shot) and Figure 9 CoT ablations included. Factuality Table 6 CIs are 95% confidence intervals as stated.
